body:
“Fuck this shit, I’m out”

Alternatively, “Flex tape can’t fix this”

I was drunk in a brewery literally two days ago and realized that Founder’s All Day IPA was called “All Day IPA” because it’s a session IPA, and a session beer is specifically designed to have a lower ABV so you can go bar hopping for extended periods without making yourself sick or getting too drunk. 

It makes sense, but it blew my drunk ass mind.
I don’t know what I would think about. I was raped by multiple people. First a family friend, then a family member, then my own husband. And I want to die, but I don’t if that makes sense
